notes:
Inbound via product signup -> quick qualification call. SMB focused (mental health postpartum coaching app). Interested in Hosted API only for now (self-serve) but legal asks could push to Dedicated later. 

Call notes (03/02) - Jordan/Jordan
- Quote from CEO: "We cannot store PHI, but some content will be sensitive — need clear retention controls."
- Primary workload: conversational coaching (chat), plus doc search for provider content and appointment triage flows.
- Latency target: ~150-300ms p50 for short chat replies; acceptable p90 up to 700ms. Peak throughput modest: ~40-60 rps peaks (expected bursts around product sessions).
- Cost sensitivity: early-stage, want low per-token cost; open to quantized model recommendations.
- Model preference: small/medium open models with safety/filters; ask about Redwood verified models + fallback to cheaper variant.
- Security asks: SSO/SAML, audit logs for admin actions, retention policy (need delete-by-user), encryption at rest (KMS). Legal asked: Clarify HIPAA stance (they're HIPAA-adjacent, not covered entity).

POC idea: 2-week integration window, sample dataset (synthetic patient snippets) to validate prompt flows, measure latency/cost. They asked for trial tokens (1k) and SOC2 summary + retention API docs.

Follow-up (03/09): security kickoff with SE (Priya) — walked through auth flows, suggested caching strategy (prefix cache + session KV) to reduce token spend. SE noted need to show audit log example and retention/del data flow diagram.

Sales notes: tone = fast-moving, engineering-first. CEO technical. Procurement likely to request PO and updated T&Cs if POC looks good. Next comms: send SOC2 + retention API spec + example code sample (node/python) for tokenized session deletion.

Stubs/links: Drive deck + SOC2 doc attached. Fireflies call ids above. Jira RDW-3124 opened for retention-API clarification.
